fields.name: mandate_date
fields.description: Date written in the date box at the top right of the mandate

fields.name: action_type
fields.description: Action indicated by tick mark: CREATE, MODIFY, or CANCEL

fields.name: sponsor_bank_code
fields.description: Sponsor bank IFSC or code printed or entered (e.g., HSBC02INDIA)

fields.name: utility_code
fields.description: Utility code printed or filled in the utility code field (e.g., NACH00000000023118)

fields.name: account_type
fields.description: Type of bank account ticked: SB, CA, CC, SB-NRE, SB-NRO, or Other

fields.name: bank_account_number
fields.description: Customer bank account number written in the account number grid

fields.name: bank_name
fields.description: Name of the customer's bank (with Bank)

fields.name: ifsc_code
fields.description: 11-character IFSC code filled in the IFSC grid boxes

fields.name: amount_in_words
fields.description: Mandate debit amount written in words in the 'an amount of Rupees' line

fields.name: amount_in_figures
fields.description: Mandate debit amount written in numbers in the ₹ box

fields.name: frequency
fields.description: Debit frequency ticked: Monthly (Mthly), Quarterly (Qtly), Half-Yearly (H-Yrly), Yearly (Yrly), or As & when presented

fields.name: debit_type
fields.description: Debit limit type selected: Fixed Amount or Maximum Amount

fields.name: reference_1
fields.description: Application, customer, or policy reference number entered in Reference 1

fields.name: phone_number
fields.description: Contact telephone or mobile number written in the Phone No. field

fields.name: email_id
fields.description: Customer email address written in the Email ID field

fields.name: period_from_date
fields.description: Start date for mandate validity entered in the 'From' boxes (DD/MM/YYYY)

fields.name: period_to_date
fields.description: End date for mandate validity entered in the 'To' boxes (DD/MM/YYYY)

fields.name: account_holders
fields.description: List of account holders/signatories authorized to operate the account and signing the mandate (slots 1, 2, and 3)
